description: Schema for actual data about countries. Decimal separator - dot symbol '.', thousands separator is not used. In descriptions to all fields there is an example of what the value will look like in JSON for Canada.

capital.description: Name of the capital city de jure (can be None if there are no capital). Example: 'Ottawa'

area_total.description: The area of the country in square kilometers (includes units of measure). Example: '9984670 sq. km'

area_rank.description: Country's rank in the world by it's area. Example: 2

gdp_total.description: Country's nominal GDP in USD (includes units of measure in the answer). Example: '2.14 trillion USD'

gdp_total_rank.description: Country's rank in the world by it's total nominal GDP. Example: 9

gdp_per_capita.description: Country's nominal GDP per capita in USD (includes units of measure in the answer). Example: '53371 USD'

gdp_per_capita_rank.description: Country's rank in the world by it's nominal GDP per capita. Example: 20

population_total.description: Country's population amount (includes units of measure in the answer). Example: '41465298 people'

population_rank.description: Country's rank in the world by population. Example: 37

population_density.description: Country's population density in people by square kilometer (includes units of measure in the answer). Example: '4.35 people per sq. km'

population_density_rank.description: Country's rank in the world by it's population density. Example: 186

established.description: Year of establishment or independence (the most recent if there were few). Example: 1867

former_owner.description: Previous colonial power or powers if there were any (None otherwise). Example: 'United Kingdom'

religion.description: Country's official religion (can be None if there are no official religion). Example: 'None'

languages.description: Country's official language or languages. Example: ['English', 'French']
